decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to combine the powerful abilities of Acererak the Archlich with a variety of black mana acceleration and disruption spells to create a strong combo strategy. By utilizing cards like Dark Ritual, Yawgmoth's Will, and Cabal Ritual, the deck aims to quickly generate large amounts of mana to cast game-winning spells like Tendrils of Agony or Emrakul, the Promised End. Additionally, the deck includes a range of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to disrupt opponents' strategies and protect the combo. With the ability to quickly generate mana and disrupt opponents, this deck aims to control the game and win with a powerful combo finish.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent with a combination of creatures and burn spells, aiming to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The deck includes a variety of aggressive creatures like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Dragon's Rage Channeler, as well as burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lightning Helix to remove threats and finish off the opponent. In addition, the deck includes cards like Blood Moon and Chained to the Rocks to disrupt the opponent's mana base and board development. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and efficient removal, ultimately securing a quick victory in a one-on-one match.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies using two Partner commanders, Bruse Tarl, Boorish Herder and Yoshimaru, Ever Faithful.
